topics.title: 课程作业
topics.summary: 2026/27 指引将考核分为 AI-integrated、AI-assisted、AI-minimal、AI-prohibited 四档；须遵守本次考核说明的档位及准许用途。
topics.scope: AI-minimal 只允许不改变其他结构或内容的拼写语法检查，不包括 ChatGPT、Copilot 等生成式 AI；获准辅助技术的例外须另看适用范围。

claims.text: The 2026/27 guidance uses four assessment tiers: AI-integrated, AI-assisted, AI-minimal and AI-prohibited. Follow the tier and permitted purposes in your assessment brief.

evidence.quote: The University of Exeter follows a four-tier approach to GenAI use in assessments:
evidence.title: GenAI use in assessments

claims.text: The 2026/27 guidance uses four assessment tiers: AI-integrated, AI-assisted, AI-minimal and AI-prohibited. Follow the tier and permitted purposes in your assessment brief.

evidence.quote:
You may use AI tools for checking spelling and grammar mistakes only, with no other impact on the structure or content of the assessment. This includes AI tools such as Microsoft Word's grammar and spelling checker, and  not  GenAI tools such as Microsoft Copilot or ChatGPT. This is because using AI tools outside of these uses prevents fair assessment of your ability to achieve module learning outcomes.  
				 While completing AI-minimal assessments, you may find that some search tools you are using have GenAI features, such as source summarisation tools. Do not copy, paste or paraphrase information from these AI-generated summaries.
evidence.title: GenAI use in assessments

claims.text: The 2026/27 guidance uses four assessment tiers: AI-integrated, AI-assisted, AI-minimal and AI-prohibited. Follow the tier and permitted purposes in your assessment brief.

evidence.quote:
The University's guidelines on the use of GenAI in assessments appreciate that assistive technology using AI may have been recommended as part of the Disabled Students Allowance / Apprenticeship Needs Assessment Process. The majority of these tools are allowed even in AI-prohibited assignments. If there is any uncertainty with this please check with your Faculty Hub via SID:  https://sid.exeter.ac.uk/ 

 If you would like to discuss this further please engage with  AccessAbility .
evidence.title: GenAI use in assessments

topics.evidenceScope: AI-minimal allows spelling and grammar checking without other structural or content changes; it excludes GenAI tools such as ChatGPT and Copilot. Approved assistive-technology exceptions need their own scope.

topics.title: 考试
topics.summary: 四档框架并不构成考试通用 AI 许可，须核对本场考核档位及说明。
topics.scope: 现有来源针对考核；考试形式、监考及辅助调整须看具体说明。

claims.text: The four-tier framework does not establish blanket AI permission in an exam. Check the tier and instructions for the actual assessment.

topics.title: 披露
topics.summary: 在 AI-integrated 及 AI-assisted 考核中，提交物须包含提示词，并尽可能附输出链接；记录直接与间接使用，并引用直接使用的内容。
topics.scope: 提交记录与参考引用属于不同要求；将超过单词或短语的内容翻成英语，须由考核说明明确同意。

claims.text: For AI-integrated and AI-assisted assessments, include GenAI prompts and, where possible, links to outputs in the submission. Record direct and indirect use; reference direct use.

topics.title: 隐私与数据
topics.summary: 使用大学账户，并确保所输入或上传信息的分类级别符合该工具获准处理的级别。
topics.scope: 企业协议不代表所有工具拥有相同数据权限，须核对具体工具的当前目录。

claims.text: Use the university account and match the tool’s approved information-classification level to the information you enter or upload.

evidence.quote: When you are logged into these tools with your University account, the information you enter, share or create is covered by the University’s enterprise-level data agreements and security arrangements. Different tools are approved for different  information classification levels , so check the AI Catalogue before using a tool to make sure it is suitable for the information you want to enter or upload.
evidence.title: Student AI Catalogue
evidence.location: AI catalogue / university accounts and data classification

topics.evidenceScope: Enterprise agreements do not grant every tool the same data permissions; check the current catalogue for the specific tool.

topics.title: 研究与发表
topics.summary: 自 2024 年 8 月 1 日起，PGR 学生须在升级评审材料及最终论文中声明是否及如何使用 AI；科研使用须有批判性审查与研究监督。
topics.scope: 官方 PGR 页面同时出现“文末参考文献前”和“标题页”位置措辞，放置位置仍有冲突，须向当前手册或导师核实；缺少声明会被视为未使用生成式 AI。

claims.text: Since 1 August 2024, PGR students must include an AI-use statement in the upgrade portfolio and final thesis, including whether and how AI was used. Research use requires critical scrutiny and oversight.

evidence.quote: From 1 August 2024, all Postgraduate Researchers (PGR) must include a statement in their upgrade portfolio and final thesis.
evidence.title: Research training and skills | Doctoral College

claims.text: Since 1 August 2024, PGR students must include an AI-use statement in the upgrade portfolio and final thesis, including whether and how AI was used. Research use requires critical scrutiny and oversight.

claims.text: Since 1 August 2024, PGR students must include an AI-use statement in the upgrade portfolio and final thesis, including whether and how AI was used. Research use requires critical scrutiny and oversight.

evidence.quote:
Where to put the statement 
 The statement must be placed at the end of the upgrade or thesis/dissertation documents, before the reference list. 
 What to include

claims.text: Since 1 August 2024, PGR students must include an AI-use statement in the upgrade portfolio and final thesis, including whether and how AI was used. Research use requires critical scrutiny and oversight.

topics.evidenceScope: The official PGR page contains both end-before-references and title-page placement wording. Placement remains unresolved and must be checked with the current handbook or supervisor. Missing the statement is treated as no GenAI use.
